einzeiler: The 1986 murder of student Scott Macklem in Port Huron, Michigan.
kurzfassung: On November 5th, 1986, a student named Scott Macklem was shot and killed at a community college in Port Huron, Michigan. The shooting shocked the local community and left police baffled. Investigators eventually focused on a young man who lived across the state as a suspect.

beschreibung:
On the morning of November 5th, 1986, students at a community college in Port Huron, Michigan, heard the sound of what many thought was a car backfiring. It was a gunshot, and it killed a student named Scott Macklem. The murder would leave the community shocked, and police baffled. Until they found a suspect: a young man who lived across the state.
